points.title: 音乐启蒙时期
points.description: 1882年6月17日，斯特拉文斯基出生于俄罗斯圣彼得堡的一个音乐世家。父亲是帝国歌剧院的低音歌手，母亲是钢琴家。尽管家庭环境充满音乐氛围，但斯特拉文斯基最初学习的是法律，而非音乐。在圣彼得堡大学学习法律期间，他跟随里姆斯基-科萨科夫学习作曲理论和和声学。这段时期他创作了早期的作品，包括《幻想谐谑曲》和《牧神午后前奏曲》的改编版，这些作品已经展现了他对和声创新的初步探索。
points.descriptionEn: Born on June 17, 1882, in Saint Petersburg, Stravinsky came from a musical family—his father was a bass singer at the Imperial Opera and his mother a pianist. Despite this musical environment, Stravinsky initially studied law rather than music. While studying law at the University of Saint Petersburg, he took private lessons in composition and harmony with Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov. During this period, he composed his early works, including the 'Scherzo fantastique' and an arrangement of Debussy's 'Prélude à l'après-midi d'un faune,' already showing his early explorations in harmonic innovation.

points.title: 创作突破期
points.description: 1909年，斯特拉文斯基创作了《火鸟》芭蕾舞剧，这部作品为他赢得了国际声誉。在俄罗斯乌拉尔地区的创作过程中，他开始发展自己独特的音乐语言。1910年，《火鸟》在巴黎歌剧院首演，由佳吉列夫的俄罗斯芭蕾舞团演出，获得了巨大成功。随后，他创作了更具争议性的《春之祭》（1913年），这部作品在巴黎香榭丽舍剧院首演时引发了骚乱。《春之祭》的创新节奏和不协和音程彻底改变了人们对音乐的理解，标志着现代主义音乐的重要里程碑。
points.descriptionEn: In 1909, Stravinsky composed 'The Firebird,' which brought him international recognition. While working in the Ural region of Russia, he began developing his unique musical language. In 1910, 'The Firebird' premiered at the Paris Opera, performed by Diaghilev's Ballets Russes, achieving great success. He then created the more controversial 'The Rite of Spring' (1913), which caused a riot at its premiere at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées in Paris. The innovative rhythms and dissonances of 'The Rite' completely changed people's understanding of music, marking a significant milestone in modernist music.

points.title: 新古典主义探索
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，斯特拉文斯基移居瑞士，远离了俄罗斯的动荡。在瑞士期间，他的音乐风格发生了重要转变，从早期俄罗斯民族风格转向新古典主义。这一时期创作的《士兵的故事》（1918年）体现了这种转变，作品融合了爵士乐元素和古典形式。他还创作了《普尔钦奈拉》（1920年），这部作品以18世纪音乐风格为基础，但加入了斯特拉文斯基独特的和声处理。在瑞士，他开始频繁与艺术家和作家合作，拓展了艺术表达的边界，为后来的跨艺术形式创作奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of World War I, Stravinsky moved to Switzerland,远离ing the turmoil in Russia. During his time in Switzerland, his musical style underwent a significant transformation, shifting from his early Russian nationalist style toward neoclassicism. 'The Soldier's Tale' (1918) composed during this period exemplifies this shift, blending jazz elements with classical forms. He also created 'Pulcinella' (1920), based on 18th-century musical styles but with Stravinsky's distinctive harmonic treatments. In Switzerland, he began collaborating frequently with artists and writers, expanding the boundaries of artistic expression and laying the foundation for later cross-artistic form works.

points.title: 国际声望确立
points.description: 1920年，斯特拉文斯基移居巴黎，成为国际艺术界的中心人物。在巴黎期间，他继续发展新古典主义风格，创作了《俄狄浦斯王》（1927年）、《诗篇交响曲》（1930年）等重要作品。他与佳吉列夫的俄罗斯芭蕾舞团保持密切合作，创作了《婚礼》（1923年）、《浪子回头》（1929年）等芭蕾舞剧。巴黎时期，斯特拉文斯基的音乐理论也日益成熟，他开始系统阐述自己的音乐理念，强调音乐的形式结构和节奏创新。这一时期，他的作品在欧洲和美国广泛演出，确立了作为20世纪最重要作曲家之一的地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1920, Stravinsky moved to Paris, becoming a central figure in the international art world. During his Paris years, he continued developing his neoclassical style, composing important works like 'Oedipus Rex' (1927) and 'Symphony of Psalms' (1930). He maintained close collaboration with Diaghilev's Ballets Russes, creating ballets such as 'Les Noces' (1923) and 'The Fairy's Kiss' (1929). In Paris, Stravinsky's musical theories also matured, as he began systematically articulating his musical ideas, emphasizing formal structure and rhythmic innovation. During this period, his works were widely performed in Europe and America, establishing his status as one of the most important composers of the 20th century.

points.title: 流亡与转型
points.description: 1939年，随着第二次世界大战的爆发，斯特拉文斯基移居美国洛杉矶，开始了他的流亡生活。在洛杉矶期间，他的音乐风格再次发生转变，开始探索序列主义和十二音技法。1940年代，他创作了《钢琴与管弦乐协奏曲》（1941年）、《俄军进行曲》（1942年）等作品。1945年，他成为美国公民。在洛杉矶，斯特拉文斯基不仅继续作曲，还开始频繁录制自己的作品，使他的音乐通过录音得到更广泛的传播。这一时期，他还开始与电影制片人合作，为电影创作配乐，拓展了音乐的表现形式和影响力。
points.descriptionEn: In 1939, with the outbreak of World War II, Stravinsky moved to Los Angeles, United States, beginning his exile. During his time in Los Angeles, his musical style transformed again as he began exploring serialism and twelve-tone techniques. In the 1940s, he composed works such as the 'Concerto for Piano and Orchestra' (1941) and the 'Overture to The Russian Dance' (1942). In 1945, he became a U.S. citizen. In Los Angeles, Stravinsky not only continued composing but also began frequently recording his own works, allowing his music to reach wider audiences through recordings. During this period, he also collaborated with filmmakers, creating film scores, expanding the expressive forms and influence of his music.

points.title: 晚年大师
points.description: 1945年后，斯特拉文斯基主要居住在纽约，继续创作直到1971年去世。这一时期，他完全转向序列主义创作，创作了《诗篇交响曲》（1958年）、《安魂曲》（1966年）等晚期作品。在纽约，他成为哥伦比亚大学的客座教授，影响了一代美国作曲家。1950年代和1960年代，他频繁在欧洲和美国巡回演出，指挥自己的作品，成为音乐界的传奇人物。1962年，他回到苏联访问，这是他离开23年后的首次回国，受到了热烈欢迎。1971年4月6日，斯特拉文斯基在纽约去世，享年88岁，被安葬在威尼斯的圣米歇尔岛墓地。
points.descriptionEn: After 1945, Stravinsky primarily resided in New York, continuing to compose until his death in 1971. During this period, he fully embraced serialism, composing late works such as the 'Threni' (1958) and the 'Requiem Canticles' (1966). In New York, he became a visiting professor at Columbia University, influencing a generation of American composers. In the 1950s and 1960s, he frequently toured Europe and America, conducting his own works, becoming a legendary figure in the music world. In 1962, he returned to the Soviet Union for a visit, his first return in 23 years, receiving a warm welcome. Stravinsky died in New York on April 6, 1971, at the age of 88, and was buried in the cemetery on the island of San Michele in Venice.

appraisal.zh: 斯特拉文斯基通常被认定为20世纪最具创新性的作曲家之一，从《春之祭》的原始节奏到新古典主义再到晚期序列主义，他不断拓展音乐表达的边界，其影响溢出音乐而及于艺术、文学与电影。也有研究者指出，他的音乐偏重技巧而情感深度不足，新古典主义更像保守的回归，其政治立场亦有争议。总体而言，他仍是现代主义音乐的标志性人物。
appraisal.en: Stravinsky is generally recognized as one of the most innovative composers of the twentieth century, extending the boundaries of musical expression from the primal rhythms of The Rite of Spring through neoclassicism to late serialism, with influence reaching beyond music into art, literature and film. Yet some researchers argue that his music privileges technique over emotional depth, that neoclassicism was a conservative return rather than genuine innovation, and that his political stance remains controversial. Overall he stands as a seminal figure of modernist music.

supporter.zh: 斯特拉文斯基被赞誉为20世纪最具创新性和影响力的作曲家之一。他的音乐革命性地改变了现代音乐的发展轨迹，从《春之祭》的原始节奏到新古典主义的回归，再到晚期的序列主义，他不断突破音乐表达的边界。支持者认为他代表了艺术创新的最高典范，其作品融合了不同文化元素和音乐传统，展现了真正的跨文化视野。他的音乐理论和实践影响了整个20世纪的音乐创作，为后世作曲家提供了丰富的灵感源泉。
supporter.en: Stravinsky is celebrated as one of the most innovative and influential composers of the 20th century. His music revolutionarily changed the trajectory of modern music development, from the primal rhythms of 'The Rite of Spring' to the neoclassical return, and finally to serialism in his late period. Supporters view him as the epitome of artistic innovation, whose works integrated diverse cultural elements and musical traditions, demonstrating a truly cross-cultural perspective. His musical theories and practices influenced 20th-century music composition as a whole, providing a rich source of inspiration for future composers.

critic.zh: 批评者指出斯特拉文斯基的音乐存在形式主义倾向，过于强调技巧而缺乏情感深度。他们认为他的作品虽然技术上精湛，但往往缺乏真正的音乐灵魂。此外，斯特拉文斯基在政治立场上也受到批评，特别是他在二战期间与法西斯政权的暧昧关系，以及后来对苏联共产主义的态度转变。批评者还认为他过于依赖过去的音乐形式，新古典主义时期实际上是一种保守的回归，而非真正的创新。
critic.en: Critics point out that Stravinsky's music exhibits formalist tendencies, emphasizing technique over emotional depth. They argue that while his works are technically brilliant, they often lack true musical soul. Additionally, Stravinsky faced criticism for his political stance, particularly his ambiguous relationship with fascist regimes during World War II and his later shifting attitude toward Soviet communism. Critics also contend that he relied too heavily on past musical forms, with his neoclassical period representing a conservative return rather than genuine innovation.

objective.zh: 在历史学和流行文化中，斯特拉文斯基被定义为现代主义音乐的标志性人物，其影响力超越了音乐领域，延伸到艺术、文学和电影等多个领域。他的《春之祭》首演事件已成为文化史上的经典案例，象征着现代主义与传统美学的决裂。斯特拉文斯基的生平本身也成为一个传奇故事，反映了20世纪欧洲知识分子的流亡经历和艺术适应过程。在流行文化中，他的音乐被广泛引用和改编，成为现代艺术符号的一部分，持续影响着当代音乐创作和表演实践。
objective.en: In historiography and popular culture, Stravinsky is defined as a seminal figure of modernist music, whose influence extends beyond music into multiple art forms including visual arts, literature, and film. The premiere of 'The Rite of Spring' has become a classic case study in cultural history, symbolizing the rupture between modernism and traditional aesthetics. Stravinsky's life itself has become a legendary narrative, reflecting the exile experiences and artistic adaptation processes of 20th-century European intellectuals. In popular culture, his music has been widely quoted and adapted, becoming part of the modern artistic lexicon and continuing to influence contemporary musical composition and performance practices.

self.zh: 音乐本身，除了声音的运动之外，什么也不是。
self.en: Music itself, apart from the movement of sounds, is nothing.
